claude_proposed_widenings.name: range field on ActivatedAbilityMechanics (or ActivatedAbilityHeader)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The wand fires a ranged ray at a creature within 60 feet. ActivatedAbilityMechanics has no range field, so the tracer emits 'range Self' for the target attachment — factually wrong. MagicItemSpawnedCreatureMechanics and TriggeredReactionAbilityMechanics already carry a range field; the same field is needed on ActivatedAbilityMechanics for ranged activated items.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: toward a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself
